items.name: Lens-Maker's Glasses
items.effect: Your attacks have a 10% (+10% per stack) chance to critically strike for double damage.
items.priorityReason: Reliable damage scaling for almost every attack build.

items.name: Paul's Goat Hoof
items.effect: Increases movement speed by 14% (+14% per stack).
items.priorityReason: Movement solves routing, dodge windows, and pickup safety.

items.name: Soldier's Syringe
items.effect: Increases attack speed by 15% (+15% per stack).
items.priorityReason: Best when your survivor converts frequent hits into damage or procs.

items.name: Tougher Times
items.effect: 15% (+15% per stack) chance to block incoming damage. Unaffected by luck.
items.priorityReason: A strong general survival pickup when the run lacks protection.
items.stackFormula: Block chance: 15% × stacks; capped by game behavior.

items.name: Cautious Slug
items.effect: Increases base health regeneration by +3 hp/s (+3 hp/s per stack) while outside combat.
items.priorityReason: Useful recovery between fights; not a substitute for combat survival.

items.name: AtG Missile Mk. 1
items.effect: 10% chance to fire a missile for 300% (+300% per stack) total damage.
items.priorityReason: High-value proc damage that scales with frequent hits.
items.stackFormula: Missile damage: 300% total damage × stacks after the first.

items.name: Ukulele
items.effect: 25% chance to fire chain lightning for 80% total damage on 3 (+2 per stack) targets.
items.priorityReason: Efficient crowd clear for hit-heavy builds.

items.name: 57 Leaf Clover
items.effect: All random effects are rolled an extra (+1 per stack) time for a more favorable outcome.
items.priorityReason: Excellent only after you already have worthwhile chance-based effects.

items.name: Shatterspleen
items.effect: Gain critical chance. Critical strikes bleed enemies; bleeding enemies explode on death.
items.priorityReason: A premium crit payoff that adds both single-target pressure and clear.

items.name: Shaped Glass
items.effect: Double base damage, but halve maximum health.
items.priorityReason: A deliberate risk choice; avoid it when the run cannot survive mistakes.

items.name: Plasma Shrimp
items.effect: While you have a shield, fire missiles when you hit an enemy.
items.priorityReason: Strong with shield support; consider whether corrupting AtG fits the build.
